title: Pablo Escobar's most dangerous smuggling operation is still breeding 🦛
caption:
4 hippos in 1981. Over 150 today. Colombia has a problem. 🦛
Tag the friend who'd want one as a pet 👇
first_comment: Tag the friend who'd adopt one 👇
sources: Shurin J. B. et al. (2020) 'Ecosystem effects of the world's largest invasive animal', Ecology 101: e02991 (Escobar's four hippos; population projections)

Castelblanco-Martínez D. N. et al. (2021) 'A hippo in the room: Predicting the persistence and dispersion of an invasive mega-vertebrate in Colombia', Biological Conservation 253 (population about 80-100 in 2020; could reach over 1,400 by 2040)
Reuters / BBC (March-November 2023) Colombian government plan: sterilisation, relocation to India and Mexico, and euthanasia; estimated 169 hippos
